transport: Bundled Tor via WalletCore TorTransport and CPrivacyTransport

statusDefinitions.PASS: Fixed deployment, onchain quote and full swap call simulation. No signing or broadcast.
statusDefinitions.QUOTE: Fixed deployment and onchain quote. Full swap simulation not exercised: token-input probes do not obtain allowances, and native-input probes require sufficient public fixture balance.
statusDefinitions.DEPLOYMENT: Fixed deployment verified. A specific pool/token pair was not exercised by this probe.

summaryBasis: Best validated scope for each deployment across these runs; all attempts including transient failures are retained below.

notes: Mock allowance/approval/receipt regression separately covers every catalog entry; live probes do not replace funded end-to-end acceptance.
All 26 EVM catalog networks are represented, including Ethereum Sepolia; the remaining 25 are mainnets.
The initial Arbitrum LFJ probe used USDC.e without a qualifying pool. The retry uses the already configured native USDC token and passes full simulation.
Tor connection interruptions for Aerodrome and Unichain were retried through fresh isolated Tor sessions using the same configured RPC endpoints.
